notes.text:
This update for emacs fixes the following issues:

- CVE-2026-79992: zero-click local command execution via TRAMP (bsc#1275927).
- CVE-2026-108976: flawed username input regex validation in TRAMP can cause arbitrary OS command injection
  (bsc#1284345, bsc#1284990).
